stem.text: Light of a single frequency is incident on a diffraction grating. Seven bright spots are observed on a screen.
Which change will result in an increase in the number of bright spots observed?

A.text: Increase the distance between the grating and the screen.

B.text: Increase the frequency of the incident light.

C.text: Increase the intensity of the incident light.

D.text: Increase the number of lines per metre in the grating.
